title: Man dies as he is being arrested
article: RCMP and the coroner's office are investigating the death of a man as he was being arrested.

Western Communities RCMP said Mladen Cujko, 33, of Burnaby, apparently suffered a heart attack as police and paramedics struggled to subdue him at the side of the TransCanada Highway about Monday evening.
Staff-Sgt. Bruce Brown said police got several calls about a man acting erratically, running into traffic, and even trying to get into strangers' cars.
Cpl. Murray Bayles persuaded Cujko to go with him to hospital.
As Bayles was driving, Cujko apparently went berserk, forcing the officer to pull over. He ended up struggling with the man on the side of the road.
A passing paramedic crew stopped to help. Cujko died after being handcuffed.
